title: Understanding AWS IAM Roles in a Secure Cloud Environment
objectives: Identify and describe AWS IAM roles
List existing IAM roles in an account

mission_brief.situation: You are a cloud security operator tasked with identifying and managing AWS IAM roles for your organization.
mission_brief.mission: List existing IAM roles in the account to ensure secure access and permissions.
mission_brief.execution: Use the AWS CLI to list all IAM roles in the account.

prerequisites: Basic understanding of AWS IAM concepts

content.concept: IAM Roles: Secure Access and Permissions
content.walkthrough: List existing IAM roles using the AWS CLI.
checkpoints: Verify that the IAM role is correctly configured for access to necessary resources.
common_mistakes: Incorrectly configuring IAM roles, leading to security vulnerabilities.

lab.setup: Set up an AWS CLI environment with credentials for the us-east-1 region.
safety: Do not delete or modify existing IAM roles without proper authorization.

bug_injection.bug: Incorrect IAM role configuration causing security vulnerabilities.
bug_injection.fix: Correctly configure IAM roles for secure access and permissions.

pass_conditions: List of existing IAM roles is accurate and up-to-date.
fail_conditions: IAM role configuration causes security vulnerabilities.

interrogation_questions: What are the best practices for configuring IAM roles?
How do you troubleshoot IAM role-related security issues?

allowed: List existing IAM roles using AWS CLI.
prohibited: Delete or modify existing IAM roles without proper authorization.

resume_bullets: Identified and listed existing IAM roles in the account.
Configured IAM roles for secure access and permissions.
